quantize_model_zero_shot: quantize a PyTorch model using ZeroShotCompressor with round-to-nearest quantization and return the quantized model and layer config
quantize_single_block_rtn: quantize a single model block via round-to-nearest using ZeroShotCompressor quantize_block method without calibration data
compress_llm_with_config: compress an LLM model by passing an AlgConfig to ZeroShotCompressor and calling quantize for blockwise RTN quantization
quantize_with_low_gpu_mem: quantize a model with low GPU memory usage enabled by setting low_gpu_mem_usage to True in ZeroShotCompressor
quantize_with_immediate_saving: quantize a model and write shards immediately during blockwise quantization using ZeroShotCompressor with is_immediate_saving enabled
